mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_data.text_data_source ( tenant_id, knowledge_space_id, id, name, status, version, content_version, published_content_version, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{knowledgeSpaceId}, #{id}, #{name}, #{status}, #{version}, #{contentVersion}, #{publishedContentVersion}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, knowledge_space_id::text AS knowledge_space_id, id::text AS id, name, status, version, content_version, published_content_version, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at FROM knowledge_data.text_data_source WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_space_id = #{knowledgeSpaceId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, knowledge_space_id::text AS knowledge_space_id, id::text AS id, name, status, version, content_version, published_content_version, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at FROM knowledge_data.text_data_source WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_space_id = #{knowledgeSpaceId} AND id = #{id}

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, knowledge_space_id::text AS knowledge_space_id, id::text AS id, name, status, version, content_version, published_content_version, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at FROM knowledge_data.text_data_source WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_space_id = #{knowledgeSpaceId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT request_fingerprint, knowledge_space_id::text AS knowledge_space_id, data_source_id::text AS data_source_id, result_status, result_version, result_content_version, result_published_content_version FROM knowledge_data.text_data_source_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND operation = #{operation} AND idempotency_key_hash = #{keyHash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_data.text_data_source_content ( tenant_id, knowledge_space_id, data_source_id, version, object_key, sha256, byte_size, media_type, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{knowledgeSpaceId}, #{dataSourceId}, #{version}, #{objectKey}, #{sha256}, #{byteSize}, #{mediaType}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO knowledge_data.text_data_source_request ( tenant_id, operation, idempotency_key_hash, request_fingerprint, knowledge_space_id, data_source_id, result_status, result_version, result_content_version, result_published_content_version, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{operation}, #{keyHash}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{knowledgeSpaceId}, #{dataSourceId}, #{resultStatus}, #{resultVersion}, #{resultContentVersion}, #{resultPublishedContentVersion}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO knowledge_data.outbox_event ( tenant_id, event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, occurred_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{eventId}, 'TEXT_DATA_SOURCE', #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSONB), #{occurredAt} )
